P0598.title: Abstract 6743: Peripheral immune profiling from the DIET trial - A randomized double blinded dietary intervention study in melanoma patients receiving immunotherapy

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文为综述提供了关于肠道菌群-免疫轴在实体瘤免疫治疗中作用的具体临床和转化证据。它直接关联了饮食干预（通过改变菌群）与外周免疫细胞（特别是单核细胞和T细胞）表型的改变，并展示了这种改变与ICB疗效改善的相关性。对于解释“肠道菌群如何调节ICBI疗效”这一核心问题，本文提供了从饮食到菌群再到宿主免疫系统的完整链条片段，特别是强调了单核细胞减少作为潜在生物标志物的价值。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅针对黑色素瘤；样本量小；主要展示相关性而非因果确证；未直接测量菌群组成变化，而是通过FMT间接推断菌群介导的作用。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了高纤维饮食通过调节肠道菌群进而改善ICB疗效的临床观察证据。具体显示高纤维饮食组患者外周血中单核细胞和树突状细胞减少，效应T细胞增加，且这些变化在联合免疫治疗患者中更明显。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于支持“肠道菌群成分/多样性可通过饮食调节从而影响ICB疗效”的观点。可作为饮食干预作为辅助治疗手段提升免疫治疗效果的实证案例。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 机制描述基于表型变化和动物模型推论；具体由哪些菌群物种介导、通过何种代谢产物（如短链脂肪酸）作用于宿主免疫细胞的具体分子路径未在摘要中详述；需结合其他文献补充具体的分子机制细节。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了潜在的免疫调节机制：高纤维饮食可能通过降低循环中单核细胞和树突状细胞（已知与不良ICB预后相关）的频率，同时增强T细胞激活状态，从而改善抗肿瘤免疫。动物实验表明这种益处依赖于供体粪便（即菌群）的状态。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于解释ICB疗效差异的潜在免疫学机制，特别是单核细胞/树突状细胞在抑制抗肿瘤免疫中的作用，以及T细胞效应功能增强的路径。可用于讨论“菌群-免疫代谢-免疫细胞功能”的调控网络。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 帮助确立饮食干预作为一种非药物、可操作的调节手段在肿瘤微环境管理中的地位。
broader_review_uses.material: DIET试验的设计（随机、双盲、高纤维vs对照）及早期疗效结果。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为饮食干预在肿瘤免疫治疗中可行性和安全性的背景信息，或作为未来多中心大样本研究的参考基线。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 扩展了对“外周免疫监测”在实体瘤免疫治疗中价值的理解，提示除了T细胞外，髓系细胞也是重要的调控节点。
broader_review_uses.material: 循环单核细胞和树突状细胞频率与ICB反应负相关的发现。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为潜在的血液生物标志物，用于预测或监测免疫治疗响应。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究为早期结果（early results），样本量有限，结论需谨慎外推至其他癌种或更大人群。
虽然提到了FMT证明菌群依赖性，但并未鉴定具体菌种，因此在归因于特定菌群时不能直接引用此文的菌群列表，只能引用其“菌群介导”的结论框架。
P值接近显著性的结果（p=.06）应被视为提示性而非决定性证据。
不同免疫治疗方案（联合vs单药）的亚组分析样本极小，不宜过度解读其差异性。

study_summary_A.approach: 采用混合方法设计：1. 临床队列分析：在DIET试验中，将患者按2:1比例随机分为高纤维饮食组和对照组。收集配对的外周血样本（干预前vs干预后5-8周），利用NanoString进行细胞类型去卷积和通路分析，并利用CyTOF进行蛋白质水平的免疫表型验证。2. 转化动物实验：进行人源至小鼠的粪便微生物群移植（FMT），使用患者在饮食干预前或后的粪便样本接种小鼠，随后给予黑色素瘤细胞接种和抗PD-L1治疗，最后通过CyTOF分析小鼠外周白细胞和脾脏中的免疫细胞频率，以评估饮食干预对宿主免疫反应的长期/系统性影响。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了高纤维饮食干预对接受ICB治疗的黑色素瘤患者外周免疫表型影响的早期临床证据，证实了饮食可特异性降低促炎性单核细胞并增强效应T细胞。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给材料仅为摘要，样本量较小（高纤维组n=11，对照组n=4，亚组更小），统计效力有限；部分结果（如单核细胞和DC的NanoString数据）P值处于边缘显著性（p=.06）；未提供完整的生存数据或长期疗效终点；机制主要基于相关性和动物模型推断，具体分子通路尚待深入验证。

key_findings.conditions: 高纤维饮食组 vs 对照组，干预第5-8周，NanoString分析
key_findings.finding: 高纤维组循环巨噬细胞丰度评分降低（p=.018），中性粒细胞降低（p=.035）；经典单核细胞（p=.06）和树突状细胞（p=.06）呈下降趋势。转录水平上，高纤维组T细胞激活基因签名和T细胞受体信号通路水平较高，而对照组Toll样受体信号和I型干扰素信号水平较高。

key_findings.conditions: 高纤维饮食组 vs 对照组，干预第5-8周，CyTOF验证
key_findings.finding: 高纤维组循环经典单核细胞减少（p=.0059），效应记忆T细胞频率增加（CD8+ p=.01, CD4+ p=.032）。在高纤维组内，联合使用纳武利尤单抗+伊匹木单抗的患者（n=3）相比单药治疗患者（n=7）表现出更显著的免疫变化。

key_findings.conditions: 人源至小鼠FMT实验，抗PD-L1治疗背景下
key_findings.finding: 接受高纤维饮食干预后粪便的小鼠，其循环和外周脾脏中单核细胞和树突状细胞的频率较低，且显示出改善的ICB反应。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 探究高纤维饮食干预是否以及如何通过调节全身免疫系统（特别是外周免疫细胞和微生物群介导的机制）来影响黑色素瘤患者对免疫检查点阻断疗法（ICB）的反应。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 接受免疫检查点阻断（ICB）治疗的黑色素瘤患者；研究涉及人体外周血单核细胞（PBMC）的纵向分析以及人源粪便微生物群移植（FMT）到小鼠模型的转化研究。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究基于DIET试验（NCT04645680），一项针对黑色素瘤患者的随机、双盲饮食干预II期临床试验，旨在评估高纤维饮食对全身免疫系统的影响及其与ICB疗效的关系。受试者被随机分配至高纤维饮食组（30-50 g/d）或健康对照饮食组（20 g/d）。研究通过NanoString基因表达谱分析和CyTOF质谱流式细胞术，纵向比较了干预前后PBMC的变化。此外，通过将患者干预前后的粪便移植给小鼠并进行黑色素瘤接种和抗PD-L1治疗，进一步验证饮食干预对免疫反应的影响。初步结果显示高纤维饮食可改善治疗结局，并显著改变外周免疫表型。

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: The study utilized NanoString gene expression profiling and CyTOF mass cytometry on cryopreserved paired peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) collected longitudinally. Specific immune findings included decreased abundance scores of circulating macrophages (p=.018) and neutrophils (p=.035), and reduced circulating classical monocytes (p=.0059) in the high fiber arm versus control within week 5-8. T cell activation gene signatures were higher in the high fiber arm. These immune changes were more prominent in patients receiving combination nivolumab + ipilimumab compared to monotherapy, though subgroup sample sizes were small (n=3 vs n=7). The abstract notes that circulating monocyte levels are known to negatively correlate with ICB response.
supplement_material.outline_action: Use this study as primary evidence for the feasibility and immune-modulating effects of high-fiber dietary intervention in human ICI cohorts. Cite the FMT results to support the claim of microbiome dependence. However, explicitly note that the specific human microbiome compositional changes associated with efficacy are not detailed in this abstract, requiring reference to full-text publications or complementary studies to complete the 'microbiome change' link in the human causal chain. Plan to search for full-text reports of the DIET trial that may contain the 16S/metagenomic sequencing data of the human participants.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: The success criteria requires a human diet intervention trial reporting microbiome changes with ICI efficacy causal chain. While this study is a human diet intervention trial that establishes microbiome dependence via FMT and reports improved treatment outcomes, the supplied abstract does not explicitly detail the specific human microbiome composition changes (e.g., taxa abundance shifts) that correlated with efficacy within the human cohort itself; it primarily reports human immune profiling and uses mouse FMT to infer the microbiome's causal role. Therefore, the explicit human microbiome change data linked to efficacy remains unspecified in this text.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study conducted the Phase II Diet and Immune Effects Trial (DIET, NCT04645680), a randomized double-blinded dietary intervention in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). Patients were randomized (2:1) to a high fiber diet (30-50 g/d) versus a healthy control diet (20 g/d). The authors reported early results showing the intervention is feasible with promising improvements in treatment outcomes. While the primary human data focused on peripheral immune profiling (showing reduced circulating monocytes and increased effector-memory T cells in the high fiber arm), the study included translational human-to-mouse fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) studies. In these FMT experiments, mice receiving stool from patients post-high fiber intervention demonstrated improved ICB response compared to pre-intervention stool, suggesting microbiome-dependent benefits. The authors conclude that the high fiber diet mediates regulation of peripheral immunity during immunotherapy in a microbiome-dependent manner.

While the primary human data focused on peripheral immune profiling (showing reduced circulating monocytes and increased effector-memory T cells in the high fiber arm), the study included translational human-to-mouse fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) studies. In these FMT experiments, mice receiving stool from patients post-high fiber intervention demonstrated improved ICB response compared to pre-intervention stool, suggesting microbiome-dependent benefits. The authors conclude that the high fiber diet mediates regulation of peripheral immunity during immunotherapy in a microbiome-dependent manner.

P0600.title: Engineering microbial metabolites to modulate tumor immunity and advance cancer immunotherapy

review_planning_B.planning_summary: This review serves as a foundational resource for understanding the mechanistic link between gut microbiota metabolites and ICI efficacy. It provides detailed mechanistic descriptions for key metabolite classes, clinical case studies of FMT success, and a critical analysis of why current probiotic trials show mixed results. It is particularly useful for explaining *how* metabolites work (mechanisms) and *what* the current clinical evidence base looks like (limitations and opportunities).

facet_contributions.boundaries: Mechanisms are largely derived from preclinical models or correlative clinical data; direct causal proof in all human contexts is not established. Effects are highly context-dependent (tumor type, dose).
facet_contributions.contribution: Details the molecular mechanisms of SCFAs (HDAC inhibition, GPCR activation), Tryptophan metabolites (AhR signaling), Bile acids (FXR/TGR5), and Polyamines (autophagy/mitochondrial fitness) in modulating T cell function, DC maturation, and Treg induction.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Use to explain the specific biological pathways through which the microbiome influences ICI response. Can be used to contrast pro-inflammatory vs. anti-inflammatory metabolite effects.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Clinical data is primarily from Phase I/II trials and observational cohorts; sample sizes are small. No Phase III survival benefit confirmed yet. Probiotic trials show variable/mixed results.
facet_contributions.contribution: Summarizes clinical evidence linking specific metabolite profiles (high SCFAs, low Kynurenine) to better ICI outcomes in melanoma and NSCLC. Describes FMT case studies where non-responders became responders after microbiome transfer.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Use to provide evidence for the association between microbiome status and ICI efficacy. Illustrates the potential for microbiome modulation to overcome resistance.

facet_contributions.boundaries: This is a proposed framework for future research; it does not represent completed large-scale validation.
facet_contributions.contribution: Discusses the heterogeneity of probiotic effects and proposes a 'mechanism-to-trial' pipeline for future studies, emphasizing strain specificity and metabolite output over generic taxonomy.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Use to explain why previous probiotic interventions failed or showed inconsistent results, highlighting the need for precision approaches.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Helps frame the综述's focus on mechanisms and functional outputs rather than just species lists.
broader_review_uses.material: The review emphasizes that microbial metabolites, rather than just bacterial presence, are the active mediators of immune modulation. This supports arguments for focusing on functional outputs in综述.
broader_review_uses.purpose: Contextual background on the shift from taxonomic to functional microbiome research.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Provides necessary context on the translational barriers and safety profiles associated with microbiome interventions, relevant if the综述 discusses clinical implementation challenges.
broader_review_uses.material: Discusses FDA/EMA guidelines for Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs), FMT donor screening, and biosafety concerns (horizontal gene transfer, bacteremia).
broader_review_uses.purpose: Regulatory and safety considerations for microbiome-based therapies.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Illustrates the future direction of precision oncology integrating multi-omics data, useful for discussing technological advancements in the field.
broader_review_uses.material: Describes AI-guided patient stratification and digital twin modeling for predicting microbiome-immune responses.
broader_review_uses.purpose: Examples of AI and personalized medicine applications.

scope_interpretation_cautions: The review explicitly states that no Phase III trials have confirmed survival benefits; avoid overstating clinical efficacy.

Metabolite effects are highly context-dependent (e.g., butyrate can be beneficial in melanoma but suppressive in CRC under certain conditions); do not generalize effects across all tumor types without qualification.
Probiotic trials have shown mixed/negative results in some observational studies; distinguish between rationally designed next-generation probiotics and commercial over-the-counter supplements.
Many mechanistic insights are from murine models; human relevance should be framed as supported by correlation or early-phase trials, not definitive proof.
topic_handles: Tumor-specific context: Melanoma, CRC, HCC, NSCLC

study_summary_A.approach: The authors conducted a narrative synthesis of existing literature, integrating findings from preclinical animal models, human observational studies, and early-phase clinical trials. They categorized metabolites by chemical class and analyzed their distinct immunological effects across different tumor types. The review also includes a critical appraisal of clinical trial designs, safety profiles, and regulatory landscapes for microbiome-based therapies.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Provides a comprehensive classification of microbial metabolites (SCFAs, indoles, bile acids, polyamines) and their context-dependent immunological mechanisms across multiple tumor types.
contribution_and_limits.limits: The review acknowledges that most clinical evidence is from small, early-phase trials or observational studies; no Phase III randomized trials have confirmed survival benefits yet.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Highlights the 'dual role' of certain metabolites (e.g., butyrate, AhR ligands) where effects are highly dependent on tumor type, dose, and local microenvironment.
contribution_and_limits.limits: Mechanistic clarity in humans is limited by the complexity of the human microbiome compared to simplified murine models; causal links in humans are often inferred rather than directly proven.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Outlines emerging strategies for precision microbiome engineering, including synthetic biology (engineered probiotics) and AI-guided patient stratification.
contribution_and_limits.limits: Regulatory frameworks for live biotherapeutics and postbiotics are still evolving; standardization of assays and donor screening remains a significant barrier to clinical translation.

key_findings.conditions: In melanoma and lung cancer models; high fiber diet or butyrate supplementation
key_findings.finding: Butyrate enhances CD8+ T cell infiltration and memory formation via HDAC inhibition and GPCR signaling, synergizing with anti-PD-1 therapy.

key_findings.conditions: In colorectal cancer; high intratumoral lactate and acidic environment
key_findings.finding: Butyrate's effect may shift towards Treg induction and immunosuppression due to competition for transporters and local metabolic context.

key_findings.conditions: In hepatocellular carcinoma; colonization with DCA-producing bacteria
key_findings.finding: Deoxycholic acid (DCA) suppresses liver-resident NKT cells and promotes tumorigenesis.

key_findings.conditions: In melanoma patients treated with PD-1 blockade
key_findings.finding: Responders showed higher serum levels of SCFAs (butyrate, propionate) and indole derivatives, correlating with improved progression-free survival.

key_findings.conditions: In ICI-refractory melanoma patients receiving FMT from responders
key_findings.finding: FMT re-sensitized approximately 40% of patients to PD-1 therapy, accompanied by shifts in microbiome composition and increased intratumoral CD8+ T cells.

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: To understand the mechanistic basis of how gut microbiota metabolites modulate tumor immunity and to evaluate the translational potential of targeting these pathways to improve the response rates of immune checkpoint inhibitors in patients with solid tumors.
study_summary_A.research_scope: The review focuses on the role of gut microbiome-derived metabolites in modulating cancer immunity and their potential as therapeutic agents or biomarkers for immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) in solid tumors. study_summary_A.work_summary: This review synthesizes current knowledge on how microbial metabolites influence the efficacy of cancer immunotherapy. It details the mechanisms by which specific metabolite classes (SCFAs, tryptophan derivatives, bile acids, polyamines) interact with host immune cells to either promote anti-tumor responses or induce suppression. The paper critically evaluates clinical data linking metabolite profiles to patient outcomes, discusses the limitations of current evidence (primarily early-phase trials), and outlines future directions involving engineered microbes, AI-guided personalization, and regulatory frameworks.

It outlines a proposed 'mechanism-to-trial' pipeline to address the variability seen in previous probiotic studies, emphasizing the need for strain-specific validation and metabolite quantification. Additionally, it details regulatory frameworks (FDA/EMA) for Live Biotherapeutic Products (LBPs) and safety concerns (e.g., transmission of multidrug-resistant organisms via FMT), which are relevant for understanding the barriers to launching large-scale Phase III trials. Therefore, the gap itself is unresolved in the affirmative, though the material successfully clarifies the current state of the field.

It states that as of late 2025, 'no completed Phase III randomized trials have yet confirmed a reproducible survival benefit of microbiome-based interventions in oncology.' P0601.title: The effect of gastrointestinal microbiome supplementation on immune checkpoint inhibitor immunotherapy: a systematic review

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该综述提供了关于“肠道微生物群调节如何影响ICI疗效”这一问题的直接反面或谨慎视角证据。它不证明有效性，而是通过评估现有小规模临床试验的设计局限性和统计结果，表明在当前证据水平下，微生物群补充并未显示出超越标准ICI治疗的显著临床获益。这对于综述中讨论“现有临床证据的强度”、“研究设计的挑战”以及“为何机制明确但临床转化困难”至关重要。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅限于已发表的3项小型临床试验；结论基于与FDA历史数据的间接比较，不能直接确立因果关系；主要针对黑色素瘤和肾细胞癌。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了具体的临床结局数据：在两项单臂研究中，FMT联合ICI的ORR与ICI单药的历史基准相当，无统计学显著差异；在一项RCT中，虽然数值上联合组优于对照组，但与历史对照相比存在矛盾，且整体统计检验不显著。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于回答“肠道微生物群调节是否提高了ICI在实体瘤中的疗效”这一问题。具体用于论证目前临床证据尚不充分，或者用于展示不同研究间结果的不一致性。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 该综述本身未深入探讨分子机制细节，而是侧重于研究设计和临床结果的关联；其关于机制的评论是基于对纳入研究的元评估。
facet_contributions.contribution: 指出了当前研究在机制探索上的局限性：多数研究主要关注安全性、微生物组成变化（如Bifidobacterium丰度）和免疫细胞亚群变化，而临床终点（ORR, PFS, OS）多为次要终点。同时强调了研究设计（如抗生素预处理、缺乏盲法）可能混淆机制与疗效的解释。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于讨论“哪些机制介导了这种效应”时，说明目前临床阶段的研究更多是描述性的（观察微生物/免疫变化），而非确证性的因果机制研究；可用于解释为何机制假说难以在临床层面得到验证。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 用于说明该领域仍处于早期阶段，存在大量的理论推测和观察性研究，但缺乏高质量的干预性证据，这有助于解释为什么综述需要强调高质量RCT的重要性。
broader_review_uses.material: 文献景观分析显示，关于微生物群与ICI的研究中，综述和评论文章占比极高（PubMed 48.3%，Embase 27.0%），而前瞻性实验研究和随机试验极少（<2.5%）。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 提供领域背景和研究现状评估

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 可作为综述中讨论“如何评估此类新兴联合疗法的证据等级”或“处理非随机对照试验数据时的方法论挑战”的素材。
broader_review_uses.material: 描述了使用Jadad量表评估研究质量，以及当缺乏对照组时使用FDA公开数据进行基线比较的方法论尝试及其局限性。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 提供研究方法论的参考案例

scope_interpretation_cautions: 该综述的结论是‘没有显著差异’或‘证据有限’，而非‘无效’。它强调的是当前研究设计的不足导致无法确认疗效，而非微生物群绝对不起作用。
引用的FDA数据作为对照，虽指示相同肿瘤类型，但患者人群、入排标准和治疗方案可能存在差异，因此比较仅为假设生成性质，不能作为确证性证据。
纳入的研究样本量极小（N=10-30），统计效能低，任何阴性结果都不能排除微小但重要的临床获益。

study_summary_A.approach: 采用系统综述方法。首先进行文献景观分析，对前100条结果按研究类型分类以评估领域内研究设计分布。其次，针对干预性临床试验进行二次系统检索，纳入英文原始文章，排除观察性、回顾性及动物研究。数据提取包括患者人群、研究设计、质量和结局指标。使用Jadad量表评估受控试验的质量。对于无对照组的单臂试验，利用FDA公开数据作为基线比较器，通过卡方检验比较观察到的ORR与预期ORR的差异。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了关于微生物群调节剂联合ICI治疗早期临床试验设计缺陷的全面评估，揭示了该领域从理论热情到实证验证之间的差距。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 仅纳入3项研究，样本量极小；两项关键研究为单臂且无对照，依赖外部FDA数据进行间接比较，内部效度受限；未进行荟萃分析因研究异质性高。

key_findings.conditions: 针对接受pembrolizumab或nivolumab治疗的转移性黑色素瘤患者的两项单臂FMT试验
key_findings.finding: 观察到的ORR（分别为20%和30%）与FDA注册的ICI单药治疗ORR（24%和32%）相比，差异无统计学意义（p=0.73, p=0.91）。

key_findings.conditions: 接受nivolumab-ipilimumab联合治疗伴或不伴益生菌CBM588的转移性肾细胞癌随机对照试验
key_findings.finding: 联合组ORR为58%，对照组为20%；联合组中位PFS为12.7个月，对照组为2.5个月。但与历史对照（CheckMate 214试验中nivolumab-ipilimumab组ORR 42%，PFS 11.6个月）相比存在不一致，且总体统计比较未显示显著优势（p=0.15）。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 在癌症免疫治疗中，补充胃肠道微生物群是否能提高免疫检查点抑制剂的疗效？目前的临床研究证据是否支持这一假设？
study_summary_A.research_scope: 针对使用免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）治疗实体瘤（主要是黑色素瘤和肾细胞癌）的患者，评估粪便微生物群移植（FMT）或其他胃肠道微生物群调节剂作为补充治疗的临床试验设计特征及临床结局。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 这是一篇系统综述，旨在评估将胃肠道微生物群调节剂（如FMT或益生菌CBM588）与标准免疫检查点抑制剂联合使用的临床研究现状。作者通过检索PubMed和Embase数据库，筛选出3项符合纳入标准的干预性研究（2项单臂试验，1项随机对照试验）。研究发现，现有研究样本量小（10-30人），设计质量普遍较低（Jadad评分低），且缺乏对照组。尽管其中一项研究显示联合治疗组的客观缓解率（ORR）和无进展生存期（PFS）高于对照组，但通过与FDA注册数据的对比分析，统计学上未发现联合治疗显著优于单独使用ICI的证据。结论指出当前证据不足以证实微生物群补充能改善ICI疗效，呼吁开展更大规模、随机、双盲的临床试验。

auxiliary_material: 综述使用了 Jadad 量表评估纳入研究质量，得分较低（1-3 分），主要因缺乏随机化和盲法。
对于缺乏对照臂的研究，作者尝试使用 FDA 公开的单药试验数据作为基线进行比较，但注明这仅为假设生成性质，存在方法学局限性。
文献景观分析显示，该领域综述和评论文章占比高（PubMed 48.3%），而前瞻性实验研究极少（<2.5%），反映了领域处于早期阶段。
纳入研究的主要终点多为安全性或微生物组成变化，临床终点（OS/PFS）多为次要终点，且部分未定义（如 Dizman 2022 的 OS）。
supplement_material.outline_action: 在综述中引用此系统性 review 作为核心证据，声明截至 2022 年中尚无已发表的 Phase III RCT 证实微生物组干预在 ICI 中的疗效。建议补充检索 ClinicalTrials.gov 等注册平台，查找状态为'Completed'的 Phase III 微生物组-ICI 联合试验，以更新'unmet'状态的时效性。若注册库也无记录，则可确证该 gap 为'unmet'。
supplement_material.remaining_gap: 该材料仅覆盖至 2022 年 7 月发表的文献，无法排除此后完成或发表的 Phase III 试验，也无法确认正在进行的注册试验（如 NCT 编号）的最新状态。材料确认了截至检索日无已发表的大规模 Phase III RCT，但需结合临床试验注册库以确认是否有已完成但未发表或正在进行的 III 期试验。

在 205 篇初筛文章中，仅 3 篇符合纳入标准，样本量均在 10 至 30 人之间，无大规模试验。

统计比较显示，现有小型试验的 ORR 与 FDA 历史单药数据无显著差异，提示目前证据不支持微生物组补充能显著提高 ICI 疗效。

文献景观分析显示，该领域综述和评论文章占比高（PubMed 48.3%），而前瞻性实验研究极少（<2.5%），反映了领域处于早期阶段。
纳入研究的主要终点多为安全性或微生物组成变化，临床终点（OS/PFS）多为次要终点，且部分未定义（如 Dizman 2022 的 OS）。
supplement_materials.outline_action: 在综述中引用此系统性 review 作为核心证据，声明截至 2022 年中尚无已发表的 Phase III RCT 证实微生物组干预在 ICI 中的疗效。建议补充检索 ClinicalTrials.gov 等注册平台，查找状态为'Completed'的 Phase III 微生物组-ICI 联合试验，以更新'unmet'状态的时效性。若注册库也无记录，则可确证该 gap 为'unmet'。
supplement_materials.remaining_gap: 该材料仅覆盖至 2022 年 7 月发表的文献，无法排除此后完成或发表的 Phase III 试验，也无法确认正在进行的注册试验（如 NCT 编号）的最新状态。材料确认了截至检索日无已发表的大规模 Phase III RCT，但需结合临床试验注册库以确认是否有已完成但未发表或正在进行的 III 期试验。
useful_material: 该系统性综述检索了 PubMed 和 Embase 数据库（截至 2022 年 7 月），专门寻找评估微生物组调节剂联合 ICI 治疗的临床试验，检索词包含 Phase 3 临床试验。
在 205 篇初筛文章中，仅 3 篇符合纳入标准，样本量均在 10 至 30 人之间，无大规模试验。
纳入的 3 项研究中，2 项为单臂研究（Phase 1/2），1 项为随机对照但样本量小（Phase 1，N=30），无已完成的 Phase III RCT。
综述结论明确指出当前研究设计有限，缺乏随机、大样本、有对照的试验，未来需要此类试验来确定临床效果。
统计比较显示，现有小型试验的 ORR 与 FDA 历史单药数据无显著差异，提示目前证据不支持微生物组补充能显著提高 ICI 疗效。

P0602.title: Fecal microbiota transplantation plus pembrolizumab and axitinib in metastatic renal cell carcinoma: the randomized phase 2 TACITO trial

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文为综述提供了关于肠道微生物群如何具体调节实体瘤（特别是肾细胞癌）中免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效的高质量RCT证据。其核心价值在于区分了“总体菌群改变/定植”与“特定菌株动态”对临床预后的不同影响，并指出了特定有益/有害菌株的作用，这有助于回答综述中关于机制特异性和菌群功能模块的问题。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅适用于mRCC一线联合治疗场景；样本量小，主要终点未达显著性；供体来源单一。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了FMT干预对ICI疗效影响的直接临床证据。显示d-FMT可显著延长mRCC患者的中位PFS（HR=0.50），并在IMDC中/高危亚组中显著改善12个月PFS率。同时指出总体定植率与疗效无关，提示效应可能依赖于特定的菌群重构而非简单的丰度增加。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于支持“肠道菌群调节可增强ICI疗效”的论点，并强调不同肿瘤类型或风险分层下效应的异质性。可用于讨论FMT作为ICI增敏策略的临床潜力及其局限性（如主要终点未达标）。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 基于观察性关联，非因果证明；特定菌株的功能验证需在体外或动物模型中进一步确认；Akkermansia的作用存在争议（通常认为有益，此处特定株系可能有害或指示 dysbiosis）。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了介导效应的潜在微生物机制：1. 特定菌株的获得（如Blautia wexlerae）与良好预后相关；2. 特定菌株的丢失（如基线Ruminococcus bromii）或与有害菌（如Akkermansia massiliensis）的获得与较差预后相关；3. 总体菌群多样性增加和基线物种的大量置换可能是重塑微环境的关键。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于阐述“哪些具体的微生物特征或动态变化与ICI响应相关”。可作为机制层面的具体案例，说明并非所有菌群改变都有益，需关注特定菌株的功能属性（如SCFA产生、炎症调节）。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 背景与现状：当前FMT在实体瘤ICI治疗中的证据等级。
broader_review_uses.material: TACITO试验是首个针对mRCC的FMT-RCT，填补了从回顾性关联到因果干预证据的空白。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为领域内高质量临床证据的代表，展示当前FMT研究的进展与挑战（如主要终点未达标、操作复杂性）。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 方法学参考：FMT制剂与给药方案。
broader_review_uses.material: 描述了从供体筛选、粪便处理（冷冻保存、胶囊化）、结肠镜与口服给药的具体流程，以及宏基因组菌株水平分析（StrainPhlAn）的方法。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 为综述中关于FMT标准化、质量控制及微生物组分析方法学的讨论提供具体实例。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 对比与反例：Akkermansia muciniphila/massiliensis的双重角色。
broader_review_uses.material: 研究发现获得A. massiliensis (SGB9228) 与较短PFS相关，这与以往许多研究中A. muciniphila作为生物标志物的正面作用形成对比或补充。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于讨论微生物标志物的复杂性和情境依赖性，避免简单化的“好菌/坏菌”二分法。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 主要终点（12个月PFS率）未达到统计学显著性（P=0.053），尽管趋势明显，但不能宣称FMT在该终点上确证有效。
中位PFS的显著改善是次要终点，需谨慎解读其作为主要疗效证据的地位。
微生物组发现多为相关性分析，特别是特定菌株与预后的联系，需结合其他研究验证其因果性。
供体均为ICI完全缓解者，且主要来自单一供体，结果可能受供体特异性影响，外推至普通健康供体或混合供体时需验证。
未进行抗生素预处理，这可能影响了定植效率，与其他使用抗生素预处理的研究结果不可直接比较。
topic_handles: specific microbial taxa (Bifidobacterium, Blautia, Akkermansia, Ruminococcus)

study_summary_A.approach: 这是一项单中心、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的2a期临床试验。纳入符合一线帕博利珠单抗+阿昔替尼治疗资格的mRCC患者。排除近期使用抗生素、胃肠道疾病或自身免疫病史的患者。供体选自既往接受ICI治疗后达到长期完全缓解的mRCC患者。实验组（d-FMT）接受来自供体的粪便移植（首次结肠镜灌注，后续胶囊口服），对照组（p-FMT）接受安慰剂。主要终点为12个月PFS率；次要终点包括中位PFS、中位总生存期（OS）、客观缓解率（ORR）、安全性及微生物组变化。采用全基因组鸟枪法宏基因组测序分析菌群组成及菌株水平定植（DoSER）。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了首个针对mRCC患者的一线ICI联合治疗背景下，供体FMT干预的随机对照试验证据，证实了d-FMT在改善中位PFS方面的潜在疗效及安全性。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 样本量较小（N=45用于主要终点分析），导致主要终点未达统计显著性；多数粪便由单一供体提供，限制了结果的普适性；未进行抗生素预处理，可能影响定植效率；随访时间虽长但死亡事件数不足，OS结果尚不成熟。

key_findings.conditions: 意向治疗人群（ITT）及全分析集（FAS）
key_findings.finding: 主要终点12个月PFS率在d-FMT组（70%）高于p-FMT组（41%），但未达到预设的显著性阈值（P=0.053）。

key_findings.conditions: 全分析集（FAS）
key_findings.finding: 次要终点中位PFS在d-FMT组显著长于p-FMT组（24.0个月 vs 9.0个月，HR=0.50, P=0.035）。ORR在d-FMT组为52%，p-FMT组为32%。

key_findings.conditions: 事后分析：IMDC中/高危预后患者
key_findings.finding: 在IMDC中位或不良预后亚组中，d-FMT的优势更明显，12个月PFS率差异具有统计学显著性（63% vs 27%, P=0.045），中位PFS分别为18.8个月 vs 5.1个月（P=0.033）。

key_findings.conditions: 微生物组分析：整体定植
key_findings.finding: d-FMT组显示出显著的供体菌株定植（DoSER持续升高），且α-多样性（Shannon指数）和β-多样性（Bray-Curtis距离）较基线显著增加。然而，总的供体菌株定植率（DoSER）高低与12个月PFS无显著关联。

key_findings.conditions: 微生物组分析：特定菌株动态
key_findings.finding: 特定菌株的获得或丢失与临床结局相关。第1周获得供体Blautia wexlerae菌株与较长的12个月PFS正相关；而获得Akkermansia massiliensis (SGB9228) 或与基线Ruminococcus bromii菌株的丢失负相关。此外，d-FMT组患者基线物种的丢失比例较高，且这种丢失在维持PFS>12个月的患者中更显著。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 鉴于肠道微生物群可能调节ICI疗效，且现有证据多来自回顾性研究或非RCT，本研究旨在通过严格的随机对照试验，验证针对mRCC患者，使用来自ICI完全缓解者的供体FMT作为辅助治疗，能否增强一线联合免疫治疗的临床获益。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 转移性肾细胞癌（mRCC）患者，一线接受帕博利珠单抗（pembrolizumab）联合阿昔替尼（axitinib）治疗。研究涉及供体粪便微生物移植（FMT）对临床疗效及肠道菌群组成的影响。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究是一项研究者发起的、随机、双盲、安慰剂对照的2a期临床试验（TACITO试验），旨在评估从免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）完全缓解者中获取的供体粪便微生物移植（d-FMT）是否能改善初治转移性肾细胞癌（mRCC）患者在接受帕博利珠单抗+阿昔替尼联合治疗后的临床结局。主要终点为随机化后12个月的无进展生存率（PFS）。结果显示，虽然主要终点未达到统计学显著性（70% vs 41%，P=0.053），但次要终点中位PFS在d-FMT组显著延长（24.0个月 vs 9.0个月，HR=0.50, P=0.035）。微生物组分析证实了供体菌株的定植以及α和β多样性的增加，并发现特定菌株的获得或丢失与临床预后相关，而总定植率则无关。

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: The study details specific microbiome mechanisms, including donor strain engraftment rates (DoSER), increased alpha-diversity in the intervention arm, and associations between specific taxa (e.g., acquisition of Blautia wexlerae linked to better PFS; acquisition of Akkermansia massiliensis linked to worse PFS). Safety data indicates FMT was well-tolerated with no serious adverse events related to the procedure. Methodological details include donor screening (ICI complete responders), FMT manufacturing (colonoscopy + capsules), and lack of antibiotic preconditioning.
supplement_material.outline_action: Report that current evidence includes Phase 2a RCTs (e.g., TACITO) showing signals of efficacy (improved median PFS) but failing primary endpoints in some analyses, with no Phase III data available in this material. Recommend maintaining the 'unmet' status for Phase III confirmation while citing Phase 2a data as the current state-of-the-art for microbiome intervention in ICI-treated mRCC.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: The supplied material does not contain evidence of a completed, large-scale **Phase III** randomized controlled trial. The highest level of evidence provided here is Phase 2a. Therefore, the success criterion requiring confirmation of a Phase III RCT with published OS/PFS data remains unfulfilled by this text, supporting the conclusion that such evidence is currently 'unmet' or at least not represented in this document.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study (TACITO trial) is an investigator-initiated, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled **phase 2a** clinical trial evaluating fecal microbiota transplantation (FMT) in 50 randomized patients (45 in full analysis set) with metastatic renal cell carcinoma (mRCC) receiving pembrolizumab plus axitinib. The primary endpoint (12-month progression-free survival rate) was not met (P=0.053), though secondary endpoints showed significantly improved median PFS (24.0 vs 9.0 months, P=0.035) and objective response rate in the donor-FMT arm. The authors explicitly state this is the first RCT to investigate targeted FMT in mRCC with PFS/OS endpoints, positioning it as Phase 2a evidence rather than Phase III.

P0609.title: Enhanced Detection of Short-Chain Fatty Acids Using Gas Chromatography Mass Spectrometry

review_planning_B.planning_summary: This paper provides a technical methodology for measuring short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs), which are key microbial metabolites. While it does not directly address the efficacy of immune checkpoint inhibitors (ICIs) or solid tumors, it offers a critical tool for quantifying the 'gut microbiome' output (SCFAs) that may mediate ICI efficacy. It serves as a reference for how SCFA levels can be accurately measured in human serum and feces, which are common biomaterials in oncology and immunology studies.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Does not provide data linking SCFA levels to ICI outcomes; only provides the analytical technique.
facet_contributions.contribution: Provides a validated method for quantifying 14 SCFAs in human serum and feces, which are potential mediators of ICI efficacy.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Can be used to support sections discussing the measurement of microbial metabolites as biomarkers for ICI response. Specifically, it details how to reliably detect SCFAs like butyrate and propionate in clinical samples.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Does not elucidate the biological mechanisms of how SCFAs modulate immunity; only addresses the analytical detection of these molecules.
facet_contributions.contribution: Details the biochemical stability and extraction challenges of SCFAs, highlighting their role as volatile, hydrophilic metabolites produced by gut microbiota.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Helps explain the technical considerations in studying the mechanism of action involving microbial metabolites. It underscores why accurate quantification is necessary to understand host-microbe interactions.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Contextualizes the importance of SCFAs as microbial products relevant to host physiology and disease.
broader_review_uses.material: Introduction discusses SCFAs' roles in immune system development, glucose homeostasis, inflammation regulation, and gut-brain axis communication.
broader_review_uses.purpose: Background information on why gut microbiome-derived metabolites (like SCFAs) are biologically significant in the context of cancer immunotherapy and host health.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Highlights the complexity of sample handling for metabolomic studies in clinical settings.
broader_review_uses.material: Emphasizes the need for strict storage conditions (-80°C) and rapid processing to prevent SCFA degradation.
broader_review_uses.purpose: Illustrates pre-analytical variables that must be controlled when investigating the link between gut microbiome/metabolites and clinical outcomes like ICI efficacy.

scope_interpretation_cautions: This is a methods paper; do not interpret its protocol description as evidence of biological findings regarding ICIs or solid tumors.
The 'proof-of-concept' nature of the 14 SCFAs means the method may not cover all relevant microbial metabolites discussed in broader ICI reviews.
Ensure that any use of this paper in the review clearly distinguishes between the *measurement capability* (this paper) and the *biological correlation* (other papers).
topic_handles: Sample preparation protocols (alkaline extraction, MTBSTFA derivatization)

study_summary_A.approach: The study describes a specific experimental workflow: 1) Sample collection and storage at -80°C; 2) Addition of NaOH to maintain basic conditions (pH ~9); 3) One-step extraction using methanol; 4) Derivatization with MTBSTFA at 60°C for 30 minutes; 5) GC-MS analysis using an Agilent system with specific column and temperature parameters; 6) Quantification via calibration curves using internal standards (hexanoic acid-d3). The approach is validated through demonstration of linearity (R² ≥ 0.95), precision, and application to standard chemical references.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Provides a detailed, validated protocol for SCFA quantification in serum and feces, including specific reagents, instrument settings, and troubleshooting steps.
contribution_and_limits.limits: The material provided is a methods paper describing a protocol; it does not present new biological data or clinical findings regarding the gut microbiome or immune checkpoint inhibitors. The 14 SCFAs monitored are described as a proof-of-concept, and the method's applicability to other specific SCFAs or sample types beyond serum/feces is not fully explored in this text.

key_findings.conditions: In vitro validation using chemical standards and described protocol conditions
key_findings.finding: The method demonstrates excellent sensitivity, linearity, and derivatization efficiency for simultaneous determination of 14 SCFAs (including acetic, propionic, butyric, and branched-chain variants).

key_findings.conditions: Comparison with existing literature methods
key_findings.finding: The alkaline extraction combined with MTBSTFA derivatization reduces analytical burden and time compared to traditional acidic, two-step extraction methods, while allowing direct injection into GC-MS.

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: To develop an efficient sample preparation and detection procedure for monitoring SCFA concentrations in human biological samples, overcoming limitations of previous acidic, multi-step extraction methods that could affect precision and increase analytical burden.
study_summary_A.research_scope: Human biological samples (serum and feces); focus on the analytical quantification of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS).
study_summary_A.work_summary: This paper presents a rapid, sensitive, and optimized protocol for extracting and quantifying 14 different SCFAs from human serum and fecal samples. The method addresses the challenges posed by the high hydrophilicity and volatility of SCFAs by employing an alkaline extraction environment (pH > 7) to reduce volatility, followed by derivatization with MTBSTFA. This allows for direct injection into GC-MS without further extraction steps. The authors demonstrate the method's linearity, sensitivity, and precision, providing detailed procedural steps, reagent specifications, and troubleshooting guidelines for researchers in metabolomics and microbiome studies.

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: Background information on SCFA biological roles (immune regulation, glucose homeostasis). Troubleshooting guide for common GC-MS issues (e.g., vacuum pressure, peak repeatability). Comparison of this alkaline extraction method to previous acidic phase separation methods, noting reduced volatility. General recommendations for minimizing freeze-thaw cycles to preserve sample integrity.
supplement_material.outline_action: Use this study to describe the technical methodology for SCFA quantification in serum within the review. Explicitly note that this protocol covers SCFAs but not inosine. Highlight the lack of TME-specific protocols and cancer-specific reference ranges as a limitation in current standardization. Search for additional literature specifically addressing inosine quantification and TME metabolite sampling.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: This study does not provide a measurement protocol for inosine. It does not address sample preparation or quantification specifically for tumor microenvironment (TME) tissue, focusing only on serum and feces. The reference ranges cited are from a general metabolomics database (HMDB) rather than a cancer-specific consensus statement or standardized reference range for tumor patients. The success criterion regarding 'consensus statements' or 'reference ranges' for cancer contexts remains unmet.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study provides a detailed Basic Protocol 1 for quantifying 14 short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum and feces using gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS). It specifies alkaline extraction (pH > 7) using sodium hydroxide, derivatization with MTBSTFA at 60 °C, and specific GC-MS parameters (e.g., oven temperature program, ion source settings). It includes a table of 14 SCFA standards with retention times and quantification masses. It references the Human Metabolomics Database (HMDB) for normal concentration ranges of acetic acid in human blood (26.8 to 64.2 μM). It outlines calibration curve requirements (R2 ≥ 0.95) and sample storage conditions (−80 °C for long-term).

P0629.title: Abstract 3275: Dietary fiber intake modifies the bile acid metabolic profile in the DIET trial - A randomized double blinded dietary intervention study in melanoma patients receiving immunotherapy

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文提供了膳食纤维通过调节肠道微生物-胆汁酸轴影响免疫治疗疗效的具体代谢证据。它连接了饮食干预、微生物代谢产物（胆汁酸）和宿主免疫反应三个环节，特别指出了次级胆汁酸减少与ICB反应改善的关联，为解释微生物如何调制ICI疗效提供了代谢层面的机制素材。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅限黑色素瘤模型和特定饮食干预背景；临床样本量有限，不能代表所有实体瘤或所有微生物组构成。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了膳食纤维作为调节因子，通过改变肠道微生物群落功能（具体表现为胆汁酸代谢谱）来增强ICB疗效的临床观察数据。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于综述中讨论‘宿主因素（如饮食）如何通过微生物中介影响ICI疗效’的部分，作为支持微生物组调控免疫治疗有效性的实证案例。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 机制主要基于小鼠FMT模型的间接推断；人体中肝脏结合能力变化的确切生理意义未完全阐明；未排除其他代谢途径的干扰。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了具体的分子机制路径：高纤维饮食 -> 减少初级胆汁酸向次级胆汁酸（DCA, LCA, UDCA）的微生物转化 -> 降低循环中次级/初级胆汁酸比值 -> 改善ICB反应。同时提示肝脏结合能力的潜在变化。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于详细阐述‘微生物介导的代谢机制’，特别是胆汁酸作为关键效应分子的角色。可用于对比其他研究中胆汁酸促进或抑制免疫的不同发现，提供‘减少次级胆汁酸有益’这一特定视角的证据。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 提供关于‘饮食-微生物-代谢-免疫’互作网络的具体实例。
broader_review_uses.material: DIET试验的设计细节（高纤维vs对照）、LC-MS/MS代谢组学分析方法、小鼠FMT实验流程。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为方法论参考或背景信息，展示如何通过多组学结合动物模型来解析饮食干预的生物学机制。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究的结论高度依赖于特定的饮食干预方案（高纤维）和特定的肿瘤类型（黑色素瘤），外推至其他实体瘤或不同饮食模式需谨慎。
临床代谢分析的样本量较小，结果可能存在统计效力不足的问题，需结合更大规模队列验证。
小鼠模型中的FMT结果虽一致，但人类肠道微生物群的复杂性和个体差异可能导致结果不完全可重复。
作者提出的‘肝脏结合能力减弱’仅为推测，缺乏直接的酶活性或基因表达数据支持。
topic_handles: fecal microbiota transplant (FMT) in melanoma models

study_summary_A.approach: 1. 临床研究设计：在DIET试验中，将接受ICB的黑色素瘤患者随机分为高纤维组（最终目标50 g/d）和对照组（20 g/d）。选取均衡期后第1-4周采集的血清样本（高纤维组n=6，对照组n=8），进行非靶向代谢组学和靶向胆汁酸谱分析，比较两组间代谢物差异。2. 动物模型验证：收集DIET试验参与者在高纤维饮食前后的粪便样本，进行成对粪便微生物群移植（FMT）至黑色素瘤小鼠模型中，评估不同供体微生物群对小鼠ICB反应及循环中胆汁酸比例的影响。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了临床证据，表明高纤维饮食干预可特异性地降低黑色素瘤患者体内次级胆汁酸的积累，并改变其代谢谱。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代临床队列的整体响应率统计显著性，仅提及“数值上更高”；临床代谢分析样本量较小（高纤维组n=6，对照组n=8）；小鼠模型样本量极小（n=5）；机制关联为相关性推断，尚未在人体中直接证实因果链条。

key_findings.conditions: 高纤维饮食组（n=6）vs 对照组（n=8），采集于均衡期后第1-4周
key_findings.finding: 非靶向代谢组学显示，高纤维组中胆汁酸及其甘氨酸/牛磺酸结合衍生物的水平显著低于对照组（p<0.05）。

key_findings.conditions: 靶向胆汁酸谱分析
key_findings.finding: 高纤维组未结合次级胆汁酸及次级/初级胆汁酸比值降低，提示膳食纤维可能减少了肠道微生物介导的初级胆汁酸向次级胆汁酸（如脱氧胆酸、石胆酸、熊去氧胆酸）的生物转化。同时，结合/未结合胆汁酸比值降低，提示肝脏胆汁酸结合能力可能减弱。

key_findings.conditions: 小鼠模型（n=5），使用DIET试验参与者高纤维饮食后的粪便进行FMT
key_findings.finding: 与使用饮食前粪便的小鼠相比，接受高纤维饮食后粪便移植的小鼠表现出更好的ICB反应，且循环中次级/初级胆汁酸比值降低。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 尽管已知膳食纤维与ICB反应相关，但其具体的系统性代谢机制尚不明确。本研究试图回答：高纤维饮食是否改变患者的胆汁酸代谢谱？这种改变是否与微生物介导的次级胆汁酸转化有关，并进而影响抗肿瘤免疫反应？
study_summary_A.research_scope: 接受免疫检查点阻断（ICB）治疗的黑色素瘤患者；研究涉及临床队列（DIET试验亚组分析）及小鼠异种移植模型。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究基于DIET试验（一项随机双盲对照饮食干预研究），旨在探讨膳食纤维摄入对黑色素瘤患者全身代谢谱，特别是胆汁酸（BA）代谢的影响。研究比较了高纤维饮食与对照饮食患者在基线至第1-4周期间的代谢变化，并利用患者粪便微生物群进行小鼠模型验证，以探索饮食干预通过调节胆汁酸代谢影响ICB疗效的潜在机制。

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: The study utilized untargeted metabolomics and bile acid profiling via LC-MS/MS on sera from 43 patients, with current analysis focusing on paired samples from high fiber (n=6) and control (n=8) arms during equilibration vs week 1-4. The human trial observed a numerically higher response rate in the high fiber arm. The mouse model involved n=5 recipients per group. The study duration was up to 10 weeks with fiber ramped from 30 g/d to 50 g/d in the intervention arm.
supplement_material.outline_action: Use this material to document that the DIET trial has identified microbiome-mediated functional changes (bile acid biotransformation) associated with dietary intervention and ICB response. Cite the mouse FMT data as supporting evidence for the mechanistic link. In the gap analysis, note that specific taxa data and formal statistical mediation analysis of microbiome-to-clinical outcomes in humans are not detailed in this abstract, indicating a need to consult full-text publications or companion reports for complete mediation statistics.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: This abstract does not list specific gut microbiome taxa compositional changes associated with the intervention in the human cohort, focusing instead on serum metabolite proxies for microbiome function. It does not explicitly report a statistical mediation analysis linking specific microbiome changes (taxa or functional pathways) to clinical outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS) in the human participants, though it links bile acid profiles to response in mouse models and notes numerical response differences in humans. There is no explicit statement that microbiome mediation data is pending or unavailable, but the reported data prioritizes metabolic profiling over microbiome sequencing results.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study reports secondary objectives from the DIET trial (NCT04645680), a randomized controlled feeding study in melanoma patients receiving immune checkpoint blockade (ICB). The authors found that a high fiber diet reduced unconjugated secondary bile acids and secondary-to-primary bile acid ratios in serum compared to control. The authors attribute these metabolic changes to reduced gut microbiota-mediated biotransformation of primary bile acids (cholic acid, chenodeoxycholic acid) into secondary bile acids (deoxycholic acid, lithocholic acid, ursodeoxycholic acid). In mouse avatar models using fecal microbiota transplant from trial participants, recipients of post-high fiber diet microbiota showed improved ICB response and decreased secondary-to-primary bile acid ratios. The authors conclude that dietary fiber modulates microbiome-mediated secondary bile acid synthesis linked to ICB response.

P0638.title: A LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine and inosine nucleotides in human cells

review_planning_B.planning_summary: This paper provides a detailed analytical methodology for quantifying purine nucleotides (ATP, GTP, ITP and their MP forms) in human blood cells. While it does not directly address gut microbiome or immune checkpoint inhibitors, it offers valuable technical context for understanding the measurement of intracellular metabolites that may influence immune responses. It also highlights the biological differences in nucleotide pools between nucleated (PBMCs) and non-nucleated (RBCs) cells, and identifies stability challenges in common clinical sampling matrices like DBS.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Does not measure nucleotides in gut tissue or directly link them to ICI efficacy. Focuses on healthy/infected baseline states rather than treatment-induced changes related to immunotherapy.
facet_contributions.contribution: Provides baseline physiological data on the relative concentrations of ATP, GTP, and ITP in PBMCs versus RBCs (10x, 55x, and 5.6x higher in PBMCs, respectively). This establishes the expected magnitude of intracellular nucleotide pools in immune-relevant cells (PBMCs) compared to other blood components.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Can be used to contextualize the scale of nucleotide changes observed in studies linking microbiome metabolites to immune cell function. Helps define the 'normal' range or ratio of these nucleotides in the target cell type (PBMCs) for solid tumor immune responses.

facet_contributions.boundaries: Specific to purine nucleotides; does not address other microbial metabolites (e.g., SCFAs, bile acids) often linked to ICI response. Does not explain the mechanism of microbiome modulation, only the analytical constraints of measuring host metabolites.
facet_contributions.contribution: Details the chemical instability of triphosphates in Dried Blood Spots (DBS), showing a 26% decrease in TP and 184% increase in MP due to hydrolysis during drying/storage. Identifies environmental contamination as a major confounder for low-abundance nucleotides.
facet_contributions.possible_uses: Useful for discussing methodological pitfalls in measuring intracellular metabolites in clinical trials. If any studies in the review use DBS for metabolite profiling, this paper serves as a cautionary example regarding sample handling and potential artifacts in nucleotide data.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Methodological Context for Intracellular Metabolism
broader_review_uses.material: The paper describes how nucleotides are primarily intracellular and how extracellular purines are typically parent forms due to phosphatase activity. It notes that plasma contamination is minimized by the strong ion exchange step.
broader_review_uses.purpose: To illustrate the complexity of measuring intracellular signaling molecules (like ATP/ADP ratios) which are often implicated in immune checkpoint regulation. Highlights that accurate measurement requires careful separation from extracellular contaminants.

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: Biological Basis for Matrix Differences
broader_review_uses.material: Explains that PBMCs have higher nucleotide levels because they are nucleated cells performing de novo synthesis, while RBCs rely on salvage pathways and use nucleotides primarily for energy.
broader_review_uses.purpose: To provide a biological rationale for why different blood cell types have vastly different metabolic profiles. This supports discussions on why PBMCs are the preferred matrix for studying immune-related metabolic changes in cancer immunotherapy.

scope_interpretation_cautions: This paper is a methodological study, not a clinical outcome study regarding ICI efficacy or microbiome composition.
The 'hydrolysis' finding in DBS is specific to the drying/storage conditions described; it does not imply all DBS samples fail, but highlights a risk factor.
Contamination issues are specific to the sensitivity of the assay and environmental factors; they do not invalidate the method but require strict controls.
Do not extrapolate the nucleotide concentration ratios (PBMC/RBC) to other tissues or disease states without evidence.

study_summary_A.approach: Method development and validation study. Cell lysates were prepared from PBMCs, RBCs, and DBS. Nucleotides were separated by charge using anion-exchange solid-phase extraction (QMA cartridges). Triphosphate fractions were enzymatically dephosphorylated to nucleosides using alkaline phosphatase. Analytes were purified via phenylboronic acid (PBA) SPE and quantified using LC-MS/MS in positive electrospray ionization mode. Validation included assessment of linearity, intra-/inter-assay precision and accuracy, matrix effects, recovery, process efficiency, conditional stability (freeze/thaw, room temperature, extracted), carryover, and cross-talk. Clinical application involved comparing MP vs. TP levels in PBMCs, PBMCs vs. RBCs, and paired RBC vs. DBS samples from 36 hepatitis C patients treated with ribavirin.

contribution_and_limits.contribution: Provides a validated LC-MS/MS method that avoids ion-suppression issues of ion-pairing HPLC by using dephosphorylation and simple aqueous mobile phases. Enables simultaneous quantification of MP and TP forms in multiple blood cell matrices.
contribution_and_limits.limits: The method is susceptible to environmental contamination (e.g., bacteria, dust) which affects the Lower Limit of Quantification (LLOQ), particularly for IMP/ITP. The utility of DBS for accurate nucleotide quantification is limited by instability/hydrolysis of TPs during sample processing and storage, requiring further evaluation or immediate processing protocols.

key_findings.conditions: Validation in PBMCs, RBCs, and DBS matrices
key_findings.finding: The assay demonstrated linear ranges of 10–2000 pmol/sample for ATP, 1.0–200 pmol/sample for GTP, and 0.25–50 pmol/sample for ITP. Intraassay precision (%CV) ranged from 1.7% to 16%, and interassay precision was within similar bounds. Accuracy (%deviation) was between -11.5% and 14.7%.

key_findings.conditions: Comparison of cell types (PBMCs vs. RBCs)
key_findings.finding: Nucleotide levels in PBMCs were significantly higher than in RBCs: 10-fold for ATP, 55-fold for GTP, and 5.6-fold for ITP. Monophosphate concentrations were generally lower than triphosphate concentrations, except for inosine.

key_findings.conditions: Comparison of DBS vs. Paired RBC Lysates
key_findings.finding: DBS samples showed an average of 26% lower triphosphate (TP) levels and 184% higher monophosphate (MP) levels compared to paired RBC lysates, suggesting hydrolysis of TPs to MPs during the DBS drying and storage process.

key_findings.conditions: Stability assessments
key_findings.finding: Analytes were stable through freeze/thaw cycles and in extracted form at room temperature for up to 6 days. However, samples in methanol/water lysate were unstable at room temperature for extended periods (>2 hours), particularly for GTP at low concentrations.

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: To develop a sensitive, specific, and robust bioanalytical method capable of simultaneously measuring physiologically relevant concentrations of MP and TP forms of adenosine, guanosine, and inosine in various clinical sample types (PBMCs, RBCs, DBS), addressing limitations of previous HPLC-UV methods such as ion suppression and inability to easily distinguish phosphorylation states without complex mobile phases.
study_summary_A.research_scope: Human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), red blood cells (RBCs), and dried blood spots (DBS) from hepatitis C-infected individuals; quantification of endogenous adenosine, guanosine, and inosine nucleotides.
study_summary_A.work_summary: This study developed and validated a liquid chromatography-tandem mass spectrometry (LC-MS/MS) method for the simultaneous quantification of adenosine, guanosine, and inosine mono- (MP) and triphosphate (TP) forms in human cellular matrices. The method employs solid-phase extraction followed by enzymatic dephosphorylation to convert nucleotides into their parent nucleoside forms for detection, thereby simplifying chromatography and avoiding ion suppression associated with ion-pairing agents. The assay was validated for accuracy, precision, linearity, and stability across PBMCs, RBCs, and DBS matrices using samples from 36 patients. Key findings include higher nucleotide concentrations in PBMCs compared to RBCs, significant hydrolysis of triphosphates to monophosphates in DBS samples during storage/drying, and identification of environmental contamination as a critical factor limiting the lower limit of quantification for certain analytes.

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: The authors observed that nucleotide levels in PBMCs were significantly higher than in RBCs (10, 55, and 5.6 fold for ATP, GTP, and ITP, respectively), attributing this to de novo synthesis in nucleated cells versus salvage pathways in RBCs. The study noted that plasma contamination is minimized by the strong ion exchange step since nucleotides are primarily intracellular and extracellular purines exist mainly in parent forms due to phosphatase activity.
supplement_material.outline_action: Search for methodological papers or consensus guidelines specifically addressing absolute quantification of short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in human serum or tumor tissue. Investigate whether standardized LC-MS/MS or NMR protocols exist for free inosine measurement in serum or TME. Look for review articles or consortium statements (e.g., Metabolomics Society) that define reference methods for these specific metabolites in clinical oncology contexts.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: This material does not establish a standardized measurement method for free inosine or short-chain fatty acids (SCFAs) in serum or the tumor microenvironment (TME). The study focuses on intracellular nucleotides in blood cells rather than absolute concentrations (μM or ng/mL) in serum or tissue. No consensus guidelines or widely adopted protocols for the specific metabolites and matrices requested in the gap (SCFAs, serum/TME inosine) are provided. The success criterion for finding consensus guidelines or widely adopted methodological papers for these specific targets remains open.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study developed and validated an LC-MS/MS method for quantifying adenosine, guanosine, and inosine nucleotides (mono- and triphosphate forms) in human peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMCs), red blood cells (RBCs), and dried blood spots (DBS). The authors reported linearity ranges (e.g., 0.25–50 pmol/sample for inosine triphosphate), intraassay and interassay precision (%CV within 1.7 to 16%), and accuracy (%deviation within −11.5 to 14.7%). The method involved solid-phase extraction followed by dephosphorylation to molar equivalent nucleosides. The study identified specific stability issues, noting that triphosphate levels in DBS were approximately 26% lower compared to paired RBC lysates due to hydrolysis during drying/storage. It also highlighted environmental contamination as a critical factor for low-abundance nucleotides like ITP, requiring strict controls and adjusted lower limits of quantification.

P0649.title: Immunotherapy efficacy in colorectal cancer is dependent on activation of a microbial-metabolite-immune circuit

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文为综述提供了关于肠道微生物如何通过特定代谢物（肌苷）调节免疫检查点抑制剂（ICB）在结直肠癌中疗效的详细机制证据。它不仅识别了具体的促效细菌，还深入到了受体（A2AR）和信号通路（cAMP-CREB）层面，并强调了肿瘤微环境中共刺激信号（IL-12/cDCs）的关键作用。此外，它提供了重要的反面案例（APC/KRAS模型无效），有助于综述讨论微生物疗法的局限性和亚型特异性。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅限于小鼠模型；细菌的定植能力依赖于ICB引起的肠道屏障改变；在APC/KRAS突变模型中无效，限制了其普适性主张。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了具体的细菌物种（B.p., L.j., Olsenella sp.）及其对ICB疗效增强的实证数据。证明了微生物的存在是ICB在CRC中有效的必要条件，并通过单菌定植实验确立了因果关系。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于回答“哪些微生物促进ICB疗效”的问题。可作为微生物调节ICB疗效的正向案例，列举具体的有益菌群。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 机制验证主要在体外和无菌鼠模型中进行；强调情境依赖性意味着不能简单地将A2AR视为单纯的免疫抑制或促进靶点；需要cDCs提供的IL-12作为共刺激，单一代谢物不足以完全解释所有现象。
facet_contributions.contribution: 详细阐述了肌苷通过A2AR-cAMP-CREB通路促进Th1分化的分子机制。揭示了该机制对共刺激信号（IFN-γ/IL-12）的依赖性，解释了为何肌苷在某些情况下促进免疫而在其他情况下抑制免疫。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于回答“机制是什么”的问题。提供代谢物介导免疫调节的具体信号通路案例。可用于讨论微生物代谢物如何直接作用于宿主免疫细胞受体。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 这是阴性结果，表明并非所有CRC都受益于该特定细菌组合；原因尚未完全阐明，需谨慎外推。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了微生物疗法在不同CRC亚型中效果差异的证据。在MMRD和炎症相关模型中有效，但在APC/KRAS模型中无效。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于讨论微生物疗法的适用范围和局限性。支持综述中关于“精准微生物疗法”或“基于亚型的治疗策略”的论点。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 背景与概念框架
broader_review_uses.material: 论文提出并验证了“微生物-代谢物-免疫”回路的概念，将微生物组研究与免疫治疗机制联系起来。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于构建综述的理论框架，说明微生物不仅通过间接炎症影响癌症，还通过产生特定代谢物直接调节免疫检查点疗法的敏感性。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 对比与反例
broader_review_uses.material: 论文指出既往文献认为腺苷/A2AR主要起免疫抑制作用，而本研究发现肌苷-A2AR在特定条件下促进Th1分化。同时，论文发现该机制在APC/KRAS模型中无效。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于讨论现有认知的复杂性（如腺苷信号的双刃剑特性）以及微生物疗法的异质性响应。提醒综述作者注意区分不同信号通路和肿瘤背景下的相反结果。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 方法学参考
broader_review_uses.material: 使用肿瘤组织而非粪便进行细菌分离和测序，以获取更直接的肿瘤-微生物互作信息。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为微生物组研究方法学的参考，提示在研究局部免疫治疗响应时，肿瘤内微生物可能比肠道整体微生物更具相关性。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究的结论基于小鼠模型，特别是无菌鼠和基因工程鼠，不能直接等同于人类患者的临床表现。
肌苷的促Th1效应高度依赖共刺激信号（如IFN-γ和IL-12），在无共刺激环境下可能无效甚至抑制，因此在综述中描述其作用时需强调情境依赖性，避免将其概括为单纯的免疫增强剂。
该细菌共疗法仅在特定的CRC亚型（MMRD、炎症相关）中有效，在APC/KRAS突变模型中无效，这表明微生物疗法不是通用的解决方案，综述中应突出这种亚型特异性。
作者声称的机制涉及A2AR信号，这与传统上认为A2AR拮抗剂用于癌症治疗的观点形成对比，需注意归因于作者的特定发现，而非领域共识。
topic_handles: 肠道微生物群与免疫检查点抑制剂（ICB）的相互作用
结直肠癌（CRC）中的微生物-代谢物-免疫回路
肌苷（Inosine）作为微生物代谢物的免疫调节作用
腺苷A2A受体（A2AR）在T细胞分化中的双重/情境依赖性角色
Th1细胞分化与抗肿瘤免疫
经典树突状细胞（cDCs）与IL-12在微生物介导的免疫增强中的作用
结直肠癌分子亚型（MMRD vs APC/KRAS）对微生物疗法的响应差异

study_summary_A.approach: 采用多阶段实验设计：首先使用无菌鼠和抗生素处理鼠验证微生物对ICB疗效的整体影响；其次，通过AOM/DSS诱导的CRC模型进行肿瘤组织16S rRNA测序和厌氧培养，筛选富集于ICB治疗组的细菌；第三，选择候选菌株对无菌鼠进行单菌定植，结合抗CTLA-4或抗PD-L1抗体治疗，评估肿瘤生长抑制和T细胞活化情况；第四，通过血清转移实验和代谢组学分析，确定介导效应的可溶性因子并鉴定为肌苷；第五，利用体外T细胞共培养体系、药理学抑制剂（A2AR抑制剂、PKA抑制剂）及A2AR缺陷小鼠，解析肌苷-A2AR-cAMP-CREB信号通路；第六，通过条件性清除经典树突状细胞（cDCs）实验，验证抗原呈递和IL-12的作用；最后，在两种不同的基因工程CRC小鼠模型（模拟MMRD和APC/KRAS突变）中测试该细菌组合对ICB疗效的影响，以评估其在不同分子亚型中的适用性。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 鉴定了三种具体的肠道共生菌（B.p., L.j., Olsenella sp.）及其关键代谢产物肌苷，阐明了“微生物-代谢物-免疫”回路在增强CRC中ICB疗效中的作用机制。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代临床队列数据，所有机制验证均在小鼠模型中进行，人体转化潜力尚需验证。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 揭示了肌苷通过A2AR-cAMP-CREB通路促进Th1分化的具体分子机制，调和了既往关于腺苷/A2AR主要起免疫抑制作用的矛盾观点，指出其效应的情境依赖性（依赖共刺激）。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代肌苷在人类患者体内的生理浓度范围及其与小鼠模型的剂量换算关系。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 明确了经典树突状细胞（cDCs）产生的IL-12是该微回路发挥抗肿瘤效应所必需的共刺激来源。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代其他类型的抗原呈递细胞（如巨噬细胞）在该回路中的潜在贡献或排除程度。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 指出了该细菌共疗法在不同CRC分子亚型中的差异性效果，为精准医疗提供了依据，即该策略可能对MMRD或炎症相关CRC更有效，而对APC/KRAS突变型无效。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代为何在APC/KRAS模型中失效的具体深层原因（如肿瘤微环境的其他抑制因素），仅推测可能与突变负荷或现有疗法不足有关。

key_findings.conditions: 无菌鼠 vs SPF鼠 / 抗生素处理鼠
key_findings.finding: ICB疗法在存在完整微生物群的SPF鼠中比在无菌鼠或抗生素处理鼠中更有效，表现为肿瘤更小、CD4+和CD8+ T细胞活化增殖增加。

key_findings.conditions: AOM/DSS诱导的CRC模型，肿瘤组织测序与培养
key_findings.finding: ICB治疗改变了肿瘤相关的细菌群落组成。从ICB治疗组肿瘤中分离出七种特有细菌，其中假长双歧杆菌（B.p.）、约氏乳杆菌（L.j.）和Olsenella sp.在后续实验中显示能显著增强抗CTLA-4疗法的疗效。

key_findings.conditions: 无菌鼠单菌定植 + 抗CTLA-4治疗
key_findings.finding: 仅定植B.p.、L.j.或Olsenella sp.不能单独抑制肿瘤，但能显著增强抗CTLA-4治疗的抗肿瘤效果，增加肿瘤内和脾脏中Th1相关T细胞的活化。

key_findings.conditions: 代谢组学与血清转移
key_findings.finding: B.p.定植导致血清中肌苷水平显著升高（8-9倍）。含有高浓度肌苷的B.p.定植鼠血清转移至无菌鼠后，足以重现抗肿瘤效应，表明效应由可溶性代谢物介导。

key_findings.conditions: 体外T细胞分化实验与药理学干预
key_findings.finding: 肌苷通过与T细胞上的腺苷A2A受体（A2AR）结合，激活cAMP-PKA-CREB信号通路，上调Il12rb2和Ifng转录，从而促进Th1细胞分化。该效应具有情境依赖性：在有IFN-γ或共刺激存在时促进Th1分化，在无共刺激时可能抑制。

key_findings.conditions: 体内A2AR信号缺失实验
key_findings.finding: 在Rag1缺陷鼠中回输A2AR缺陷T细胞后，肌苷联合ICB治疗无法增强抗肿瘤免疫，证明肌苷的促炎作用依赖于T细胞内的A2AR信号。

key_findings.conditions: 不同CRC亚型小鼠模型
key_findings.finding: 在模拟MMRD（Msh2突变）和炎症相关（AOM/DSS）的模型中，细菌共疗法显著增强ICB疗效；但在模拟APC/KRAS突变的模型中，细菌共疗法未能改善抗CTLA-4疗效，提示该机制的效果受肿瘤分子亚型限制。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 1. ICB疗法在结直肠癌中的疗效是否依赖于肠道微生物群？2. 哪些特定的肠道细菌能促进ICB疗效？3. 这些细菌通过何种分子机制（特别是代谢物和信号通路）增强抗肿瘤免疫反应？4. 这种微生物-代谢物-免疫回路在不同结直肠癌亚型中是否具有普遍性？
study_summary_A.research_scope: 结直肠癌（CRC）小鼠模型（包括异种移植MC38模型、AOM/DSS诱导的炎症相关CRC模型、以及模拟MMRD和APC/KRAS突变亚型的基因工程模型），研究肠道微生物群对免疫检查点阻断（ICB）疗法疗效的影响及其分子机制。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究旨在解决免疫检查点阻断（ICB）疗法在结直肠癌中疗效低下的问题，并探究肠道微生物如何调节这一过程。作者通过比较无菌鼠与特定病原体自由（SPF）鼠的肿瘤生长及免疫反应，证实了微生物对ICB疗效的依赖性。利用16S rRNA测序和厌氧培养从肿瘤组织中鉴定出三种促进ICB疗效的共生菌：假长双歧杆菌（Bifidobacterium pseudolongum, B.p.）、约氏乳杆菌（Lactobacillus johnsonii, L.j.）和Olsenella sp.。研究发现，这些细菌产生的代谢物肌苷（inosine）是关键介质。肌苷通过T细胞表面的腺苷A2A受体（A2AR）激活cAMP-PKA-CREB信号通路，促进Th1细胞分化。该效应依赖于ICB治疗引起的肠道屏障功能受损导致的代谢物易位，且需要经典树突状细胞（cDCs）提供的IL-12共刺激。最后，研究展示了该机制在不同CRC亚型模型中的差异：在错配修复缺陷（MMRD）和炎症相关模型中显著增强疗效，而在APC/KRAS突变模型中无效。

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: The study details the molecular mechanism (inosine-A2AR-cAMP-CREB signaling) and the context-dependency of inosine effects (requiring co-stimulation like IL-12/IFN-γ). It also reports differential efficacy of the bacterial-metabolite circuit across different colorectal cancer subtypes in mouse models (effective in MMRD and inflammation-associated models, ineffective in APC/KRAS models). These findings support the biological rationale for measuring these metabolites but do not address measurement standardization.
supplement_material.outline_action: Search for methodological papers or consensus statements from clinical metabolomics organizations regarding standard operating procedures for absolute quantification of inosine and short-chain fatty acids in human serum or tissue. Look for validation studies that compare measurement platforms or establish reference ranges for these metabolites in human populations.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: The success criteria require consensus guidelines or widely adopted methodological papers for standardized measurement of absolute metabolite concentrations in human tumor microenvironment or serum. This study provides experimental concentration data derived exclusively from mouse models (germ-free, SPF, monocolonized) using specific metabolomics facilities, without describing a standardized protocol applicable to human clinical samples or citing a consensus guideline for such measurements.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study investigated the mechanism by which gut microbiota enhance immune checkpoint blockade (ICB) therapy in colorectal cancer using mouse models. The authors identified inosine as a critical bacterial metabolite that promotes Th1 cell differentiation via the A2A receptor. They quantified absolute inosine concentrations in mouse serum and intestinal contents using untargeted metabolomics and fragmentation analysis (e.g., serum inosine in B.p. monocolonized mice was 26.16 ± 3.32µM; duodenal content was 66.13 ±14.23 µM). This material helps the gap by confirming that inosine is a quantifiable metabolite of interest and providing example concentration ranges in a biological system, demonstrating the feasibility of measuring absolute levels (µM) in serum and tissue contexts.

P0653.title: Abstract B094: Ketogenic Diet Modulates Gut Microbiome Composition and Enhances Treatment Response in Patients with Advanced Pancreatic Cancer: A Phase II Study

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文提供了生酮饮食（KD）调节肠道微生物组并与抗肿瘤治疗（特别是免疫检查点抑制剂ICIs背景下的菌群关联）互动的具体案例。虽然研究针对的是胰腺癌化疗而非直接测试ICI疗效，但其发现的菌群变化（如 Akkermansia 富集）与已知增强ICI反应的菌群特征高度重合，因此可作为解释“饮食如何通过微生物组影响肿瘤免疫微环境”的重要机制性素材，用于构建饮食-微生物-免疫治疗的跨模态联系。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 本研究对象是胰腺癌化疗患者，而非ICI治疗患者。因此，不能直接推断该饮食能增强ICI疗效，只能说明它产生了与ICI响应者相似的菌群特征。样本量小，统计效力有限。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了生酮饮食诱导特定有益菌（如 Akkermansia muciniphila, Roseburia hominis）富集的实证数据。这些菌群在文献中常与改善免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）疗效相关联。尽管本研究未直接测量ICI疗效，但它展示了饮食干预如何创造有利于免疫激活的微生物环境。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 可用于综述中论证“饮食干预可通过重塑微生物组为免疫治疗做准备”的观点。特别适用于讨论非免疫治疗药物（化疗）背景下，饮食对免疫相关菌群的间接影响，从而支持饮食作为ICI辅助疗法的潜力。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 机制推断基于相关性分析和已知文献关联（如 Akkermansia 与 ICI 的联系），并非本研究的因果实验证明。功能通路的变化（如磷脂酸代谢）与具体免疫细胞功能的直接联系在本摘要中未详细阐述。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了生酮饮食调节微生物组的具体机制线索：1）通过限制发酵纤维降低α多样性；2）促进短链脂肪酸（SCFA）产生菌（Intestinimonas, Roseburia）生长；3）改变脂质信号和氧化还原平衡相关的代谢通路（磷脂酸代谢、尿囊素降解）。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 可用于解释饮食-微生物互作的生化机制，特别是膳食纤维限制、SCFA产生与免疫调节之间的潜在联系。有助于理解为何某些饮食模式可能通过代谢产物影响宿主免疫状态。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 作为背景证据，支持“饮食干预可能独立于或协同于药物治疗影响临床结局”的观点。即使在不直接涉及ICI的研究中，这种临床获益信号也值得在综述中提及，以展示饮食干预的整体潜力。
broader_review_uses.material: MSKD组患者整体治疗反应优于SD组，且微生物组特征在治疗期间保持独特。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 提供临床疗效的背景信息，暗示微生物组变化可能与临床获益相关。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 作为反例或复杂性讨论点，说明饮食干预并非只有正面效应，也可能导致某些有益代谢途径（如维生素C合成）的抑制。这有助于综述更全面地评估饮食干预的风险收益比。
broader_review_uses.material: MSKD导致 L-抗坏血酸生物合成减少，可能与纤维限制有关。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 展示饮食干预的潜在负面或中性代谢后果，避免过度简化饮食-健康关系。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 本研究为Phase II试验，样本量极小（仅12人有微生物组数据），统计结果需谨慎解读，尤其是p值接近阈值或未达显著性的结果。
发现的菌群变化（如Akkermansia富集）是基于既往文献与ICI疗效的关联进行的推测，本研究本身并未测试ICI疗效，因此不能直接外推至ICI治疗场景。
“治疗反应更好”的具体指标（如ORR, PFS, OS）在摘要中未明确定义，需查阅全文确认。
生酮饮食的限制条件（如脂肪/蛋白质比例、持续时间）在摘要中未详细说明，可能影响结果的可重复性和外推性。
topic_handles: Ketogenic Diet (KD) / Medical Supervised Ketogenic Diet (MSKD)
Gut Microbiome Composition (Taxa: Akkermansia, Roseburia, Lacticaseibacillus)
Microbial Functional Pathways (SCFA production, Lipid signaling)

study_summary_A.approach: 这是一项随机II期临床试验的子研究。设计包括将32名可评估的转移性PDAC患者随机分配至MSKD组或标准饮食（SD）组，两组均接受相同的化疗方案（吉西他滨、白蛋白结合型紫杉醇、顺铂）。数据采集方面，从MSKD组4名患者收集13份粪便样本，从SD组8名患者收集23份粪便样本。分析方法采用Illumina NovaSeq进行深度鸟枪法宏基因组测序，使用MetaPhlAn 4.0和HUMAnN 3.6进行分类和功能微生物组表征，并使用QIIME2进行全面的生物信息学分析以评估随时间变化的微生物组组成和功能。统计方法包括Shannon多样性指数计算和ANCOM-BC方法进行差异丰度分析。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了在晚期胰腺癌化疗背景下，生酮饮食对肠道微生物组具体组成（如 Akkermansia, Roseburia 等）和功能通路影响的初步实证数据。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 所给摘要未交代完整的临床试验注册信息、主要终点定义及具体的生存数据。微生物组分析的样本量极小（仅12名患者有测序数据），导致许多关键比较（如α多样性）未达到统计学显著性。结论依赖于小样本观察，需大队列验证。

key_findings.conditions: MSKD vs SD, 化疗背景下
key_findings.finding: MSKD组患者整体治疗反应优于SD组。

key_findings.conditions: MSKD vs SD, 全疗程
key_findings.finding: 两组的微生物组特征在整个治疗过程中保持 distinct（不同）。

key_findings.conditions: MSKD vs SD, 基线/总体
key_findings.finding: MSKD组显示出较低的α多样性（Shannon diversity; p=0.1339），虽未达统计学显著性，但作者认为这可能与发酵纤维摄入减少有关。

key_findings.conditions: MSKD vs SD, 差异丰度分析 (ANCOM-BC)
key_findings.finding: MSKD组中有益菌属显著富集（p<0.05, lfc≥2），包括：Akkermansia muciniphila (p=0.17931, q=1), Intestinimonas butyriciproducens (p=3.09E-05, q=0.017), Streptococcus thermophilus (p=1.15E-05, q=0.006)。

key_findings.conditions: MSKD组内纵向变化
key_findings.finding: 仅MSKD组患者显示出 Roseburia hominis (p=3.94E-05, q=0.021) 和 Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus (p=7.28E-19, q=3.98E-16) 的持续增加，以及潜在促炎 Actinomyces spp. (p≤4.47E-05, q≤0.024) 的显著减少。

key_findings.conditions: MSKD组功能谱分析
key_findings.finding: 癌症相关微生物通路丰度增加，包括磷脂酸代谢（PWY-7039; p=4.36E-04, q=0.20）和尿囊素降解（PWY-5705; p=9.16E-06, q=0.004）。L-抗坏血酸生物合成V（PWY-6415）减少（p=3.80E-04, q=0.17），可能与纤维限制导致的D-半乳糖醛酸底物可用性降低有关。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）是一种侵袭性强、治疗选择有限且生存率低的疾病。本研究试图解决的关键问题是：医学监督生酮饮食（MSKD）是否能通过调节肠道微生物组，进而改善接受吉西他滨、白蛋白结合型紫杉醇和顺铂化疗的转移性PDAC患者的治疗反应？
study_summary_A.research_scope: 研究对象为经新诊断的转移性胰腺导管腺癌（PDAC）患者。研究情境为随机II期临床试验的一部分，干预措施为在吉西他滨、白蛋白结合型紫杉醇和顺铂化疗基础上联合医学监督生酮饮食（MSKD），对照组为标准饮食（SD）。样本量为32名可评估患者，其中微生物组测序数据来自MSKD组4名患者（13个样本）和SD组8名患者（23个样本）。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究旨在探讨医学监督生酮饮食（MSKD）对接受特定化疗方案的晚期胰腺癌患者肠道微生物组组成及治疗反应的影响。作为随机II期试验的一部分，研究者比较了MSKD与标准饮食（SD）组的临床疗效及微生物组变化。通过深度鸟枪法宏基因组测序和生物信息学分析，发现MSKD组患者整体治疗反应更好，且其肠道微生物组特征在治疗期间保持独特。尽管由于样本量限制，α多样性差异未达到统计学显著性，但差异丰度分析显示MSKD组中有益菌群显著富集，并伴随特定代谢通路的改变。这些结果提示MSKD可能通过调节肠道微生物组来支持或增强PDAC的治疗反应，但需要更大队列进行验证。

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: Study design: Randomized Phase II trial in metastatic pancreatic ductal adenocarcinoma (PDAC) patients. Treatment context: Patients received gemcitabine, nab-paclitaxel, and cisplatin chemotherapy, NOT immune checkpoint inhibitors. Sample size: 32 evaluable patients total, but microbiome data from only 12 patients (4 MSKD group with 13 samples, 8 standard diet group with 23 samples). Statistical limitations: Alpha diversity difference not statistically significant (p=0.1339) due to small sample size. The authors state further validation in larger cohorts is warranted. Treatment response metrics (ORR, PFS, OS) are not explicitly defined in the abstract. This is not the DIET trial (NCT04645680); this is a separate pancreatic cancer chemotherapy study presented at AACR Special Conference 2025.
supplement_material.outline_action: Continue searching for: (1) published results from the DIET trial (NCT04645680) specifically addressing microbiome mediation of ICI efficacy; (2) other human dietary intervention trials conducted in ICI-treated populations with formal mediation analysis; (3) explicit statements from trial investigators about whether microbiome mediation data is pending or unavailable. This study's material can be used in the review to support mechanistic plausibility (diet→microbiome→immune modulation) and to illustrate specific taxa (Akkermansia, Roseburia, butyrate producers) that are hypothesized to mediate ICI responses, but must be clearly attributed as chemotherapy-context evidence rather than direct ICI mediation evidence.
supplement_material.remaining_gap: The gap question specifically asks about the DIET trial (NCT04645680) or other human dietary intervention trials in ICI-treated patients with statistical mediation analysis linking microbiome changes to ICI clinical outcomes. This study does not address this gap because: (1) it involves chemotherapy, not ICI treatment; (2) no statistical mediation analysis was performed linking microbiome changes to clinical outcomes; (3) it is not the DIET trial. The success criteria requiring identification of published reports with microbiome mediation analysis for ICI outcomes (ORR, PFS, OS) remains unfulfilled. No explicit statement about microbiome mediation data being pending/unavailable for the DIET trial is provided in this material.
supplement_material.useful_material: This study reports specific gut microbiome compositional and functional changes associated with a medically supervised ketogenic diet (MSKD) intervention in humans. Taxonomical findings include significant enrichment of Akkermansia muciniphila (p=0.017931), Intestinimonas butyriciproducens (p=3.09E-05), Streptococcus thermophilus (p=1.15E-05), Roseburia hominis (p=3.94E-05), and Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus (p=7.28E-19) in the MSKD group compared to standard diet. Functional profiling identified increased phosphatidate metabolism (PWY-7039) and allantoin degradation (PWY-5705), with reduced L-ascorbate biosynthesis (PWY-6415). The authors note that Akkermansia muciniphila is linked to improved response to immune checkpoint inhibitors in existing literature. The study demonstrates that dietary intervention can produce sustained microbiome changes during cancer therapy, with MSKD patients showing better overall treatment responses and distinct microbiome profiles throughout therapy.

review_planning_B.planning_summary: 该论文为综述提供了关于FMT在ICI耐药实体瘤中应用的关键反面证据或阴性结果案例。它挑战了FMT作为通用挽救疗法的假设，强调了患者选择（如疾病进展速度、基线免疫状态）和供体匹配的重要性。同时，其详细的免疫学分析（CyTOF）为理解宿主免疫背景如何影响FMT疗效提供了具体的分子表型指标，有助于解释为何某些患者可能对微生物干预有反应而其他患者没有。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 样本量小，且患者多为快速进展期，结果不能外推至所有ICI耐药患者，尤其是那些病情较稳定或一线治疗有效的患者。
facet_contributions.contribution: 提供了FMT在多种非黑色素瘤实体瘤（HNSCC, RCC, MSI-H胰腺癌）中联合ICI治疗的真实世界疗效数据。结果显示ORR为0%，中位PFS仅1.5个月，表明在未经筛选的广泛耐药人群中，FMT难以单独逆转耐药。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于综述中讨论FMT疗效的不一致性，特别是作为“阴性结果”或“有限获益”的证据，反驳FMT是普适性挽救疗法的观点。可用于支持“患者选择至关重要”的论点。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 观察性关联，未证明因果；未校正多重比较；样本量限制了对亚组的深入分析；无法确定这些免疫特征是FMT无效的原因还是结果。
facet_contributions.contribution: 揭示了基线免疫表型（高分化T细胞 vs 髓系优势）与预后的强相关性，并指出FMT未能改变外周血的免疫景观（如未降低CD14+单核细胞或IL-8）。这表明FMT的潜在机制可能依赖于宿主预先存在的有利免疫环境，或者FMT本身不足以克服强烈的髓系抑制微环境。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于探讨介导FMT疗效的机制，特别是宿主免疫状态作为预测因子的作用。可用来论证“微生物干预需配合有利的宿主免疫背景”这一机制假说。对比其他研究中FMT诱导的免疫变化（如Davar et al.发现的CD56+CD8+ T细胞增加），说明不同研究中机制差异的可能原因。

facet_contributions.boundaries: 仅3名供体，且来自同一地区/体系，结论具有局限性。定植评估依赖16S测序，分辨率有限。
facet_contributions.contribution: 详细记录了FMT供体（ICI长期响应者）的使用及其对定植的影响。发现只有获得临床获益的患者实现了持久的供体菌群定植，暗示供体-受体匹配或特定微生物群落的存在可能是疗效的关键。
facet_contributions.possible_uses: 用于综述中关于“供体选择”和“微生物定植持久性”的讨论。提供证据支持“并非所有供体都同等有效”或“需要优化供体筛选标准”。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 提供FMT在ICI耐药背景下应用的负面或有限结果实例，平衡综述中可能存在的阳性报道偏差。
broader_review_uses.material: MITRIC试验的阴性主要终点（ORR 0%）和短PFS数据。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为背景信息，说明当前FMT疗法面临的挑战，即如何在异质性大的耐药患者群体中识别受益者。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 提供关于FMT安全性的具体数据，特别是irAEs的发生率和严重程度。
broader_review_uses.material: 50%的患者发生irAEs，但多数为1-2级，且与既往irAE史相关，FMT未显著增加严重毒性风险。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 用于综述中评估FMT联合免疫治疗的安全性概况，支持其在严格监控下可行的结论。

broader_review_uses.connection_to_review: 提供关于FMT给药途径（结肠镜vs灌肠）和频率的实践经验。
broader_review_uses.material: 研究采用了复杂的多次给药方案（结肠镜+灌肠），并评估了其可行性。
broader_review_uses.purpose: 作为方法学参考，讨论不同FMT给药策略的可行性和潜在影响，尽管本研究未证明疗效提升。

scope_interpretation_cautions: 该研究结果为阴性（无客观缓解），解读时需强调其样本量小和患者选择（快速进展）的限制，避免过度推广其阴性结果到所有ICI耐药场景。
免疫学发现为探索性关联，不应视为确证的机制证据，尤其需注意未校正多重比较带来的假阳性风险。
供体均为ICI响应者，结论仅适用于此类供体来源的FMT，不适用于健康供体或其他来源。
不同肿瘤类型的结果合并报告，但每种非黑色素瘤肿瘤仅1例，因此不能得出针对特定非黑色素瘤肿瘤的独立结论。
topic_handles: solid tumors (melanoma, HNSCC, RCC, pancreatic cancer)
peripheral blood mononuclear cells (PBMC) immune profiling

study_summary_A.approach: 采用单臂、开放标签的IIa期篮子试验设计。入组标准为：接受过ICI治疗后出现疾病进展的晚期实体瘤患者（包括黑色素瘤、cSCC、HNSCC、ccRCC、NSCLC和MSI-H/dMMR癌症）。供体为接受ICI治疗超过12个月响应的癌症幸存者。干预措施为最多5次的FMT（前两次结肠镜给药，后续灌肠），同时继续或重新引入ICI。主要终点为安全性（NCI CTCAE分级）和ORR（iRECIST标准）。次要终点包括无进展生存期（PFS）、总生存期（OS）、临床获益率、FMT植入定植情况（16S rRNA测序）、免疫反应（质谱流式细胞术CyTOF分析PBMCs）及血清细胞因子谱。统计分析采用Kaplan-Meier法估算生存曲线，Cox回归分析生物标志物与预后的关联，未进行多重检验校正。

contribution_and_limits.contribution: 提供了在非生物标志物驱动的广泛晚期实体瘤人群中，FMT联合ICI作为挽救治疗的安全性和初步疗效数据，证实了FMT在该人群中的安全性和可行性，但揭示了其有限的临床活动性。
contribution_and_limits.limits: 样本量极小（n=12），因招募缓慢提前终止；单臂设计缺乏对照组，无法确立因果关系；患者多为快速进展的晚期疾病，可能限制了FMT发挥作用的时间窗口；供体来源多样且数量少，可能存在供体-受体匹配问题；生物标志物分析为探索性且未校正多重比较。

key_findings.conditions: 12名ICI耐药的晚期实体瘤患者（9例黑色素瘤，其他各1例），接受来自ICI响应者的FMT联合ICI治疗
key_findings.finding: FMT总体耐受良好，无3级以上直接相关的严重不良事件（除1例结肠镜并发症外），但50%患者出现免疫相关不良事件（irAEs）。客观缓解率（ORR）为0%，中位PFS为1.5个月，中位OS为10.1个月。仅1例黑色素瘤患者达到协议定义的临床获益（稳定>6个月并存活33个月），另2例出现部分病灶消退的混合反应。

key_findings.conditions: 基于16S rRNA测序的微生物定植评估
key_findings.finding: 首次FMT后1周，大多数受体的菌群向供体方向偏移（β多样性增加相似性），但这种定植多为暂时性，后续随访中相似度下降。唯一获得临床获益的患者实现了持久的供体-受体菌群相似性。

key_findings.conditions: 基于质谱流式细胞术（CyTOF）的外周血免疫分析
key_findings.finding: 基线时，高水平的分化T细胞（CD8+ EM, TEMRA）与改善的PFS和OS相关；髓系偏倚和初始T细胞表型预后较差。这些免疫特征主要反映患者对ICIs的基础反应性和疾病状态，而非FMT干预的直接结果。FMT未引起系统性免疫微环境的显著重塑，且CD14+单核细胞和IL-8水平随时间升高，与较差预后相关。

study_summary_A.problem_or_question: 既往早期研究表明FMT可能克服ICI耐药，但其在不同肿瘤类型中的适用性、患者/供体选择标准以及具体操作方案尚不明确。本研究试图在更广泛的实体瘤人群中，评估FMT联合ICI作为挽救治疗的实际临床获益及生物学机制。
study_summary_A.research_scope: 针对晚期实体瘤（黑色素瘤、头颈部鳞癌、肾细胞癌、微卫星不稳定性高胰腺癌）中免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药或进展的患者，评估来自ICI长期响应者的粪便微生物群移植（FMT）联合ICI治疗的安全性、可行性及疗效。
study_summary_A.work_summary: 本研究是一项单臂IIa期篮子试验（MITRIC），旨在验证通过FMT调节肠道微生物群能否克服已建立的ICI耐药性。研究纳入了12名在转移性环境中对ICI治疗进展的患者，使用来自ICI长期响应者（3名供体）的粪便进行移植。主要终点为安全性（不良事件）和客观缓解率（ORR）。结果显示FMT安全可行，但未观察到客观缓解，仅见疾病稳定或混合反应。生物标志物分析发现，基线时高度分化的T细胞环境与改善的生存期相关，而髓系优势环境则预后较差；FMT未能逆转这种免疫特征，且未显著改变外周血免疫谱。

supplement_material.auxiliary_material: 研究讨论了 FMT 在 ICI 耐药背景下的挑战，包括供体选择（本研究使用 ICI 响应者作为供体）、给药途径（结肠镜联合灌肠）及患者选择（快速进展患者可能无法从 FMT 获益）。文中提及了其他早期单臂研究（如 Baruch et al., Davar et al.）的阳性结果作为对比，并引用了另一项随机试验（TACITO 试验）的近期发表结果作为未来研究方向，但未提供该随机试验的具体数据。研究强调了当前证据主要集中在早期阶段，且存在异质性。
supplement_material.outline_action: 1. 在综述中引用本研究作为当前微生物组干预 ICI 疗效证据主要为早期、小样本、单臂设计的例证，说明该领域尚缺乏大规模确证性数据。2. 针对讨论部分提及的'TACITO 试验'及其他潜在 III 期试验进行独立检索，核实其是否满足'已完成、大规模、随机对照 III 期'的标准。3. 利用本研究的免疫机制数据（如 T 细胞特征、IL-8 水平）构建关于'宿主免疫状态可能限制 FMT 疗效'的假设，解释为何大规模试验可能面临挑战。
supplement_material.remaining_gap: 本材料未提供已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验及其主要结局数据。成功标准中要求的'III 期 RCT'在此文本中未得到满足，本研究明确为 IIa 期单臂试验。因此，关于是否存在确证性 III 期证据的缺口在此材料中仍处于未解决状态。
supplement_material.useful_material: 本研究（MITRIC 试验，NCT05286294）是一项单臂、IIa 期篮子试验，纳入 12 名对免疫检查点抑制剂（ICI）耐药的晚期癌症患者（主要为黑色素瘤，另有头颈鳞癌、肾细胞癌、胰腺癌各 1 例）。研究评估了来自 ICI 长期响应者的粪便微生物移植（FMT）联合 ICI 治疗的安全性和有效性。主要结果显示客观缓解率（ORR）为 0%（0/12），中位无进展生存期（PFS）为 1.5 个月，中位总生存期（OS）为 10.1 个月。仅 1 例黑色素瘤患者达到方案定义的临床获益（稳定疾病>6 个月）。安全性方面，FMT 耐受性良好，50% 患者发生免疫相关不良事件（irAEs），多为 1-2 级。研究还通过质谱流式细胞术分析了外周血免疫细胞，发现基线高分化 T 细胞特征与较好预后相关，而髓系优势环境与不良预后相关，且 FMT 未显著改变外周血免疫景观。

supplement_materials.auxiliary_material: 研究讨论了 FMT 在 ICI 耐药背景下的挑战，包括供体选择（本研究使用 ICI 响应者作为供体）、给药途径（结肠镜联合灌肠）及患者选择（快速进展患者可能无法从 FMT 获益）。文中提及了其他早期单臂研究（如 Baruch et al., Davar et al.）的阳性结果作为对比，并引用了另一项随机试验（TACITO 试验）的近期发表结果作为未来研究方向，但未提供该随机试验的具体数据。研究强调了当前证据主要集中在早期阶段，且存在异质性。
supplement_materials.outline_action: 1. 在综述中引用本研究作为当前微生物组干预 ICI 疗效证据主要为早期、小样本、单臂设计的例证，说明该领域尚缺乏大规模确证性数据。2. 针对讨论部分提及的'TACITO 试验'及其他潜在 III 期试验进行独立检索，核实其是否满足'已完成、大规模、随机对照 III 期'的标准。3. 利用本研究的免疫机制数据（如 T 细胞特征、IL-8 水平）构建关于'宿主免疫状态可能限制 FMT 疗效'的假设，解释为何大规模试验可能面临挑战。
supplement_materials.remaining_gap: 本材料未提供已完成的、大规模随机对照 III 期试验及其主要结局数据。成功标准中要求的'III 期 RCT'在此文本中未得到满足，本研究明确为 IIa 期单臂试验。因此，关于是否存在确证性 III 期证据的缺口在此材料中仍处于未解决状态。
